title: Fall of Rome Stifles Innovation in Europe
reason: Provides an overview of the Middle Ages, detailing the social, economic, and political changes from the fall of the Roman Empire to the Late Middle Ages.

tasks.task: Describe the impact of the fall of the Roman Empire on European society during the Early Middle Ages.

subtasks.text: Observe the societal stagnation and lack of technological advancement after the fall of the Roman Empire.
Note the transition of poor villagers into the feudal system under the control of elite lords.

tasks.task: Explain the living conditions and economic roles of the poor during the Early Middle Ages.

subtasks.text: Describe the cramped and basic living quarters of poor villagers.
Highlight the attempts by the elite to collect land and establish the feudal system.

tasks.task: Analyze the changes and challenges during the High Middle Ages.

subtasks.text: Observe the role of knights and the moral focus of chivalry during the High Middle Ages.
Note the religious conflicts during the High Middle Ages, including the Great Schism and the Crusades.

tasks.task: Explain the demographic and social changes during the Late Middle Ages.

subtasks.text: Describe the effects of the Black Death on European society.
Highlight the labor shortages and wage increases following the Black Death.
